You find promo clips for a vertical microdrama. A promo is a 20-60 second clip (aim for 30-45) posted on TikTok, Instagram or YouTube to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A great promo:
1. HOOK: something in the first 3 seconds that stops a scrolling thumb — a slap, a reveal, a shocking line, a humiliation, a threat.
2. CLIFFHANGER: it ends on an unresolved moment. Cut BEFORE the answer, the reaction, or the rescue.
3. STANDS ALONE: a stranger understands who is who and what is at stake from the clip itself.

Structures you may propose:
- straight: one continuous range of atoms.
- flash_forward: segment 1 is a 2-4 second peak moment taken from LATER (same or next episode), then the setup, then the cliffhanger. Its segment 1 may use the NEXT EPISODE PEAK ATOMS listed below.

Story engines (pick the one promise the promo makes):
humiliation_reversal, dangerous_protector, hidden_identity, sacrifice_ultimatum, framed_condemned, family_betrayal, forbidden_scandal, other.

Rules:
- Use ONLY atom IDs that appear below. Never write timestamps.
- hook_id must be an atom that starts within 3 seconds of the start of segment 1 (so segment 1 should begin at most a shot before the hook).
- cliffhanger_id must be the last spoken line or action of the last segment.
- Copy hook_text and cliffhanger_text exactly from those atoms.
- Segments are given as from_id/to_id ranges of atoms in the SAME episode.
- Propose 3-6 candidates. At least ONE must be a "quiet_power" moment: a quiet, cruel, or tender line that is NOT at a listed tension hotspot.
- Prefer moments that need no prior episodes. Avoid starting on establishing shots.

SHOW BIBLE (digest):
Premise: [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
Characters:
- Mayor Brisk: [mock] speaks 53 lines between E1 and E14 (labels: MAYOR BRISK E1-14)
- Selene: [mock] speaks 46 lines between E1 and E14 (labels: SELENE E1-14)
- Widow Halloran: [mock] speaks 45 lines between E1 and E14 (labels: WIDOW HALLORAN E1-14)
- Tobin The Ferryman: [mock] speaks 40 lines between E1 and E14 (labels: TOBIN THE FERRYMAN E1-14)
- Corin: [mock] speaks 37 lines between E1 and E14 (labels: CORIN E1-14)
- Mara: [mock] speaks 28 lines between E1 and E14 (labels: MARA E1-14)
Arcs:
- E1-3 [mock] Part 1: Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
- E4-6 [mock] Part 2: Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship.
- E7-9 [mock] Part 3: Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant.
- E10-14 [mock] Part 4: A storm traps the whole family in the lighthouse overnight.
PREVIOUS EPISODE LOGLINE: Mara must light the lamp to guide in the ship carrying Corin's accusers.

E14.018 | 00:28.40-00:30.80 | DLG | SELENE (venomous, mocking) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"

E14.020 | 00:31.20-00:34.00 | ACT | the widow draws a short blade from a boot.

E14.023 | 00:34.40-00:37.06 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (nervous, cold) | "The council has already decided her fate."

E14.028 | 00:48.40-00:51.06 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (cold, triumphant) | "The council has already decided her fate."

E14.030 | 00:53.20-00:58.00 | ACT | Corin grabs Selene by the wrist.
E14.031 | 00:53.40-00:57.58 | DLG | CORIN (dry, protective) | "Marry me at dawn, and no one will dare touch you."
E14.032 | 00:58.00-01:02.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.
E14.033 | 00:58.40-01:01.44 | DLG | MARA (defiant, broken) | "Is this mercy, or is it another trap?"
E14.034 | 01:02.00-01:07.00 | CAM | Close-up on Tobin's hands gripping the rail.
E14.035 | 01:02.20-01:07.00 | ACT | Tobin grabs Mara by the wrist.
E14.036 | 01:02.40-01:05.06 | DLG | SELENE (sweet, cruel) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
E14.037 | 01:07.00-01:13.00 | CAM | Low angle on Mara framed against the lighthouse beam.
E14.038 | 01:07.40-01:09.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (pompous, nervous) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
E14.039 | 01:13.00-01:16.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E14.040 | 01:13.40-01:15.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (gruff, afraid) | "The boat leaves at the turn of the tide. Be on it."
E14.041 | 01:16.00-01:19.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Mara's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E14.042 | 01:16.40-01:18.80 | DLG | CORIN (protective, low) | "Marry me at dawn, and no one will dare touch you."
E14.043 | 01:19.00-01:24.00 | CAM | Low angle on the Mayor framed against the lighthouse beam.
E14.044 | 01:24.00-01:28.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Mara toward Tobin.
E14.045 | 01:24.40-01:27.44 | DLG | SELENE (shrill, mocking) | "A lamp-keeper's girl in my mother's lace? Never!"
E14.046 | 01:28.00-01:33.00 | CAM | Low angle on Selene framed against the lighthouse beam.
E14.047 | 01:28.40-01:31.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E14.048 | 01:33.00-01:36.00 | CAM | Low angle on the Mayor framed against the lighthouse beam.
E14.049 | 01:33.40-01:35.80 | DLG | CORIN (low, earnest) | "I came back for one reason, and she is standing here."
